remarks: Introducing this tastefully updated farmhouse situated on .93 partially wooded acres on a low-traffic street at the edge of the Village of Albion! Offering 4 bedrooms including a first floor main bedroom, 1.5 bathrooms, 1,652 square feet and a 16x25 outbuilding w/ electric and plenty of room for activities. The covered front porch greets you into the entry foyer and the large, spacious formal dining room, perfect for gathering or entertaining. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances including gas stove, dishwasher and side-by-side refrigerator, cabinets to the ceiling, a modern tile backsplash, crown molding and newer flooring. The first floor also offers a good-sized primary bedroom and main living room, a convenient laundry/storage room and half bathroom. Upstairs, you’ll find three additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a generously sized landing area offering flexible additional office, reading or play space. Head outside and relax on the attached deck overlooking the spacious yard or go explore as the property extends more than 100 feet into the woods, with approximately .38 acres of wooded land, providing a natural backdrop and added privacy. That is if you're not keeping busy in the 16x25 outbuilding w/ electric, overhead garage door and man-door. There is an additional shed in the backyard offering more storage. Additional updates: H20 tank 2024, Furnace 2016, updated windows and flooring throughout. Enjoy the convenience of Village living while benefiting from nearly an acre of land, woods, and a setting that feels tucked away from it all. A unique opportunity to enjoy space, privacy, and modern farmhouse living right in the Village of Albion! Delayed negotiations begin Tuesday, October 20th at 4pm.
